free_tier.stated: Quoted and translated from Russian: choosing the Basic Plan lets the user use the provider's free products and functions with no extra charge. Basic packages of the various products are intended to meet basic needs in a limited volume and are recommended for new enterprises and startups. Basic packages renew automatically after a 30-day period, and higher packages can be bought at any time. Free services exclude dedicated support, an SLA and compensation for breach; a Basic Support package is offered for free cloud services.
free_tier.notes: The Basic Plan renews automatically after a 30-day period; higher Growth or Professional packages can be bought at any time.
